subject: Re: Request to reinstate expired promo credits — CobaltHealth
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cobalthealth.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: CobaltHealth Procurement <procure@cobalthealth.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to reinstate expired promo credits

Hi Priyom,

We had a pilot with Redwood earlier this year (promo code REDWOOD-PILOT-2026) and the sandbox credits expired while we were waiting on internal approvals. The work stalled because of an internal compliance gate but we've cleared that now.

We'd like to request a one-time regrant of the remaining promotional credits (roughly $10,000 worth of tokens) so our engineers can finish the evaluation and finish the POC by the end of April. We're prepared to sign a PO for an initial committed spend of $25k upon successful validation.

Can Redwood make an exception to reinstate the credits? If it helps, I can share the signed NDA and the procurement timeline. Attached: a draft PO (purchase_order_cobalt_030127.pdf) and our evaluation timeline.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director of AI Engineering
CobaltHealth
liam@cobalthealth.ai

--
Attachment: purchase_order_cobalt_030127.pdf (application/pdf)
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cobalthealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reinstate expired promo credits

Hi Liam — thanks for the context and for sending the PO draft.

Quick summary of what I can commit to from the sales side: Redwood is generally conservative about re-granting expired promotional credits, but we do make exceptions when there's a clear path to purchase and an explicit onboarding plan. Two items I'll need to move this forward:

- A one-paragraph business justification (what success looks like and who will own validation)
- Confirmation that CobaltHealth will sign a PO or MSA for the initial $25k committed spend within 30 days of credit reactivation

If both are in place, I can escalate to the credits approvals team for a one-time reactivation of up to $10k in sandbox credits and propose a 60-day window for use. I'll also include an SOW addendum for any professional services if your team wants onboarding help.

Ben / Marissa — looping you in for credit exception approval and to confirm whether a smaller staged regrant (e.g., $5k followed by $5k on PO receipt) would be preferable.

Liam — if you can reply with the business justification and estimated sign date, I'll take it through approvals and provide a formal response by EOB Friday.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Midmarket
Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com

Subject: Internal: CobaltHealth credit exception recommendation

Priyom / Marissa —

I reviewed Liam's request and the attached PO. Recommendation: approve a staged regrant to reduce risk. Proposed plan:

- Regrant $5,000 sandbox credits immediately to unblock engineering testing.
- Require signed PO or P-Card confirmation for the remaining $20k committed spend within 21 days to release the second $5,000 (total $10k regrant).
- Add a short SOW (attached SOW_CobaltHealth_v2.pdf) for onboarding support (optional, billable).

Rationale: CobaltHealth is in a regulated vertical (healthcare) — staged regrant with clear procurement milestone reduces financial exposure while showing good will. If approved, I'll draft the terms and I think Marissa should sign off on the exception because it's outside standard promo policy.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cobalthealth.ai>, CobaltHealth Procurement <procure@cobalthealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T17:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reinstate expired promo credits — decision and next steps

Hi Liam / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the PO draft and the evaluation timeline. Per our internal review, Redwood will make a one-time, staged exception:

- Immediate reactivation: $5,000 in sandbox credits (usable for 60 days) to resume validation work.
- Conditional release: additional $5,000 (total $10,000) upon receipt of a signed PO for the agreed $25k initial committed spend within 21 days.

Attached: SOW_CobaltHealth_v2.pdf (onboarding addendum) and promo_terms_2026.pdf (updated promo terms reflecting the exception). Please sign the PO and return it to procure@redwood.com so we can release the second tranche.

Next steps:
1) Liam to countersign PO and confirm sign date.
2) Redwood provisioning team will credit $5k immediately once we have PO in draft (we can provision on email confirmation).
3) Redwood CS will schedule a 30-minute onboarding call (optional) to help with KV-cache and batching recommendations for your use case.

If Procurement needs a short legal addendum, loop in legal@redwood.com and we can expedite.

Appreciate the partnership — look forward to getting your team unblocked.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Midmarket
Redwood Inference
